title: ft_model 2D DWG renderer evidence ceiling and comparator admission
scope: Screen a newly identified open-source 2D DWG/DXF renderer as a possible differential observation route.
Separate implementation-source distinctness from independent semantic expected values.
Add a bounded, provenance-aware admission procedure without adding implementation or routine validation work.

sources.observed: The project describes a C++20 2D rendering engine, direct DWG/DXF parsing, JSON scene export, Canvas/WebGL rendering, and claims DWG families R2000, R2004, R2007, R2010, R2013, and R2018. The README calls DXF support full and lists common 2D entities.
sources.limitation: These are mutable-branch, project-authored claims. No immutable revision, source audit, build, fixture inspection, or runtime was performed. The consulted documentation establishes scene/JSON projection, not DXF writing or lossless model preservation.

sources.observed: The document labels itself historical and superseded by the V1.0.0 plan. Its 2026-04-23 snapshot describes a LibreDWG DWG-to-DXF plus ezdxf entity-extraction reference pipeline with tolerance-based entity matching. It reports selected-file matches of 99.8% for R2010, 99.99% for R2013, 97.0% for R2007, and 37.8% for one R2004 drawing, with a major object-map gap and missing entities. It also documents format deductions sourced from reading LibreDWG.
sources.limitation: The metrics are historical, selected-file results and are not current or version-wide qualification. Their LibreDWG-derived expected values are correlated with a common open-source oracle and cannot establish independent semantic correctness.

sources.observed: The plan identifies ezdxf-generated synthetic DXF fixtures, automated tests/fuzzing, the ODA specification as a format reference, and LibreDWG source as a read-only format-understanding reference. It states a no-copy/no-link posture for GPL code.
sources.limitation: A project plan is not proof that every listed method is implemented or independently validated. The source page is mutable and no code provenance audit was performed.

sources.observed: The report independently reinforces that its documented R2004 sample had substantial entity loss and lists unresolved block/header, dimension, rendering, old-version fixture, and other gaps as of that review.
sources.limitation: This is a dated, project-authored report and may have been superseded. It is useful to bound claims, not to state current project status.

reconciliation.decision: Track ft_model as an optional candidate for a source-pinned 2D scene/render differential only. Its expected-value path shares LibreDWG lineage and its source provenance has not been audited, so it is not an independent semantic oracle.
reconciliation.evidence_ceiling: A controlled runtime may report differences in named 2D geometry, explicit transforms, or styles in the rendered scene. It cannot establish raw object completeness, unknown-record preservation, DXF writing, round-trip fidelity, 3D topology, ACIS/ACDS semantics, or native LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/FreeCAD acceptance.
implementation_readiness: Before any optional run, pin the immutable source commit, source tree and executable hashes, build configuration, toolchain, and exact documentation snapshot; keep source review only if this identity cannot be bound.

Use only an already-owned, provenance-cleared overlapping DWG or locally-created-from-scratch controls with independently authored analytic expectations. Do not import peer DWGs, reference JSON, screenshots, or golden outputs.

Record version, file hash, operation, entity subset, coordinate frame, layout, rendering options, diagnostics, and skip counts; distinguish parser, scene projection, block expansion, and rendering dispositions.
Run only at an existing composed optional checkpoint when a named PAR/S8 question benefits. Do not add a dependency, per-slice test, CTest, fixture, or recurring peer-run gate.
Keep all support claims subject to their existing raw preservation, writer/reopen, independent semantics, and named native consumer gates.
reconciliation.plan_change: Add the optional candidate and admission protocol only; no local finding or subplan was added, and no code, test, fixture, dependency, validation frequency, external qualification, or support claim changed.
